latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the adaptive-agent-build-user-profile skill.
- Actively builds and updates a user profile by observing workspace context, git history, and conversation patterns.
- Runs on first interaction, by request, or when the profile may be outdated.
- Focuses on gathering information from context before asking the user.
- Profiles include role, technical strengths, work style, communication preferences, and current interests.
- Updates are concise (<2KB) and dated for easy staleness detection.
